name: Wir sind das Volk!

rounds.endCondition: 4 decades; East wins if neither side has won by then

categories.label: Won (this player's side)
categories.hint: Check for the winning side per the win conditions in the roles.

roles.label: East Germany
roles.winCondition: Wins immediately if it should get a Socialist but all 12 are on the board; or survives all 4 decades; or both states collapse simultaneously; or West is forced to collapse (4+ mass protest markers).

roles.label: West Germany
roles.winCondition: Wins immediately if East must lose a Socialist but has none (Socialism fails); if East must dismantle more economy than it has (National insolvency); or if East collapses (4+ mass protest markers) while West does not.

winCondition: No points. East wins: Triumph of Socialism (a new Socialist due while all 12 on board); both states collapse at once; or no one has won after 4 decades. West wins: Socialism fails (a Socialist must be removed but none on board); National insolvency (East must dismantle more than it has); or East collapses (4+ mass protest markers) while West does not. A state also loses if it collapses with 4+ mass protests.

endCondition.description: 4 decades; checked each End of Decade; East wins if nobody has won.

notes: family: asymmetric-objective. Two players. West collapse (4+ mass protests) is an East win; East collapse is a West win; simultaneous collapse is an East win.
